观察根尖分生区组织细胞的有丝分裂: Observing Mitosis in Onion Root-Tip Meristem Cells
各期细胞数 ÷ 计数总数 × 12 h = 该期时长: Cells in a phase ÷ total counted × 12 h = duration of that phase
一根洋葱根尖上，哪些细胞正在分裂？它们分裂一次各要多久？: Which cells in an onion root tip are dividing, and how long does each phase of division take?
50 个细胞里各期有几个: How many of 50 cells are in each phase
解离、漂洗、染色、制片；根尖 2~3 mm，分生区在尖端后 0.16~1.6 m: Dissociate, rinse, stain, mount; root tip 2–3 mm, meristem zone 0.16–1.6 mm behind the tip
取样框里 50 个细胞，正方形的细胞排列紧密: 50 cells in the sampling frame; square cells tightly packed
染色质、染色体、纺锤丝、细胞板: Chromatin, chromosomes, spindle fibers, cell plate
怎样把根尖做成能看清染色体的临时装片？: How do you turn a root tip into a temporary slide where the chromosomes are clearly visible?
按顺序点四个玻璃皿：解离 → 漂洗 → 染色 → 制片: Click the four dishes in order: dissociation → rinsing → staining → mounting
四个玻璃皿依次亮：解离 3~5 min（使细胞相互分离）→ 漂洗 3~5 min: The four dishes light up in turn: dissociation 3–5 min (separates the cells) → rinsing 3–5 min (washes off the reagent) → staining about 10 min (crystal violet stains the chromosomes) → mounting (squash to spread the cells)
解离：剪取根尖 2~3 mm，放进盐酸和酒精的混合液（1:1），用时 3~5 m: Dissociation: cut a 2–3 mm root tip and place it in a 1:1 mix of hydrochloric acid and ethanol for 3–5 min.
漂洗：放进清水里，用时 3~5 min，洗去药液、防止解离过度。: Rinsing: place it in clean water for 3–5 min to wash off the reagent and prevent over-dissociation.
染色：放进甲紫溶液约 10 min，使染色体着色；最后压片，使细胞分散。: Staining: place it in crystal violet solution for about 10 min to stain the chromosomes; finally squash the tissue to spread the cells.
去掉解离这一步：细胞挤在一起，压不开，看不清每一条染色体。: Skip dissociation and the cells stay clumped together, won't spread when squashed, and individual chromosomes can't be seen.
解离使组织中的细胞相互分离开来；漂洗是洗去药液、防止解离过度（教材原话）。: Dissociation separates the cells of the tissue from one another; rinsing washes off the reagent and prevents over-dissociation (textbook wording).
制片流程固定为解离 → 漂洗 → 染色 → 制片：细胞先分开、再洗去药液、再让染: The slide procedure is fixed as dissociation → rinsing → staining → mounting: separate the cells, wash off the reagent, stain the chromosomes, then squash into a single clear layer of cells.
低倍镜下，哪一段细胞在分裂？: Under low power, which zone's cells are dividing?
在 3D 里点出「分生区」，再换到 40× 物镜: Click the "meristem zone" in 3D, then switch to the 40× objective
根尖三段里，分生区的细胞呈正方形、排列紧密（教材的判别特征）；换到 40× 后视: Of the three root-tip zones, meristem cells are square and tightly packed (the textbook's identifying feature); at 40× the field shrinks, the cells grow larger and the label changes to "400× magnification · field 450 µm"
低倍扫视 → 40× 观察: Scan at low power → observe at 40×
有丝分裂常见于根尖、芽尖等分生区细胞。: Mitosis is common in meristem cells such as those of root tips and shoot tips.
分生区细胞呈正方形、排列紧密——这是教材给的判别特征。: Meristem cells are square and tightly packed; this is the identifying feature given in the textbook.
同一分生组织里各个细胞的分裂是独立进行的，所以一个视野里能看到不同时期。: Cells in the same meristem divide independently of one another, so different phases can be seen in one field.
去掉找分生区这一步：在别的区段数，几乎找不到处于分裂期的细胞（根冠、伸长区的形态: Skip finding the meristem and, counting in other zones, you will hardly find any dividing cells (the shapes of the root cap and elongation zone are illustrative; the textbook does not describe them).
观察顺序：先低倍镜找到分生区，再换高倍镜；高倍镜下先找中期细胞。: Observation order: find the meristem under low power first, then switch to high power; under high power look for metaphase cells first.
有丝分裂常见于根尖、芽尖等分生区细胞；分生区细胞呈正方形、排列紧密，换到高倍镜才: Mitosis is common in meristem cells such as root and shoot tips; meristem cells are square and tightly packed, and chromosome shapes are only clear under high power.
染色体是从哪里来的？: Where do the chromosomes come from?
把「主角细胞」从间期拨到前期: Switch the "featured cell" from interphase to prophase
染色质丝螺旋缠绕、缩短变粗成染色体；每条染色体含 2 条并列的姐妹染色单体，由一: Chromatin threads coil, shorten and thicken into chromosomes; each chromosome has 2 parallel sister chromatids joined by one centromere; the nucleolus breaks down and the nuclear envelope disappears; spindle fibers from the two poles form a spindle-shaped spindle; readings: 16 chromosomes, 32 DNA, 32 chromatids
染色质丝螺旋缠绕、缩短变粗，成为染色体。: Chromatin threads coil, shorten and thicken into chromosomes.
每条染色体包括两条并列的姐妹染色单体，由一个共同的着丝粒连接。: Each chromosome consists of two parallel sister chromatids joined by a shared centromere.
核仁逐渐解体、核膜逐渐消失，细胞两极发出纺锤丝，形成梭形的纺锤体。: The nucleolus gradually breaks down and the nuclear envelope gradually disappears; spindle fibers from the two poles form a spindle-shaped spindle.
去掉纺锤体：染色体不能被牵引，就排不到赤道板上。: Without the spindle, chromosomes can't be pulled and won't line up on the equatorial plate.
间期复制完成后染色体仍是 16 条；多出来的是 DNA（32）和姐妹染色单体（3: After replication in interphase there are still 16 chromosomes; what has increased is DNA (32) and sister chromatids (32).
前期：染色质凝集成染色体（每条 2 条姐妹染色单体），核仁解体、核膜消失，纺锤体: Prophase: chromatin condenses into chromosomes (each with 2 sister chromatids), the nucleolus breaks down, the nuclear envelope disappears and the spindle forms; the chromosome number is unchanged, DNA is already 32.
中期，染色体排在什么位置？: In metaphase, where do the chromosomes line up?
16 条染色体的着丝粒都排到细胞中央的一个平面上（赤道板），着丝粒两侧都有纺锤丝: The centromeres of all 16 chromosomes line up on a plane in the middle of the cell (the equatorial plate), with spindle fibers attached on both sides of each centromere; readings still 16 chromosomes, 32 DNA, 32 chromatids
着丝粒排列在赤道板上: Centromeres line up on the equatorial plate
赤道板与纺锤体中轴垂直: The equatorial plate is perpendicular to the spindle axis
每条染色体的着丝粒两侧都有纺锤丝附着在上面。: Spindle fibers attach on both sides of each chromosome's centromere.
纺锤丝牵引染色体运动，使着丝粒排列在细胞中央的一个平面上。: Spindle fibers pull the chromosomes so that the centromeres line up on a plane in the middle of the cell.
这个平面与纺锤体的中轴垂直，叫赤道板；教材的观察顺序是先找中期细胞，再找前期、后: This plane is perpendicular to the spindle axis and is called the equatorial plate; the textbook's observation order is to find metaphase cells first, then prophase, anaphase and telophase.
去掉纺锤丝：染色体排不到赤道板，也就没有「赤道板」这个平面可看。: Without spindle fibers, chromosomes can't line up and there is no "equatorial plate" plane to see.
赤道板是细胞中央的一个平面（位置），末期才在赤道板的位置出现细胞板（结构）。: The equatorial plate is a plane (a position) in the middle of the cell; the cell plate (a structure) appears at that position only in telophase.
中期：所有染色体的着丝粒都排列在赤道板上——一个与纺锤体中轴垂直的平面；每条染色: Metaphase: the centromeres of all chromosomes line up on the equatorial plate, a plane perpendicular to the spindle axis; each chromosome still has 2 sister chromatids.
后期染色体数为什么突然加倍？: Why does the chromosome number suddenly double in anaphase?
把「主角细胞」拨到后期，盯着丝粒: Switch the "featured cell" to anaphase and watch the centromeres
每个着丝粒分裂成两个，姐妹染色单体分开成为 2 条染色体，被纺锤丝拉向两极；读数: Each centromere splits in two, sister chromatids separate into 2 chromosomes and are pulled to the poles by spindle fibers; readings: chromosomes 16 → 32 (doubled), DNA still 32 (unchanged), chromatids 32 → 0; each pole gets a set of 16, identical in shape and number
每个着丝粒分裂成两个，姐妹染色单体分开，成为两条染色体。: Each centromere splits in two, and the sister chromatids separate to become two chromosomes.
两条子染色体由纺锤丝牵引，分别向细胞两极移动。: The two daughter chromosomes are pulled by spindle fibers toward opposite poles of the cell.
结果是两极各有一套染色体，形态和数目完全相同，也与亲代相同。: As a result each pole has one set of chromosomes, identical in shape and number to each other and to the parent cell.
去掉着丝粒分裂：两条姐妹染色单体分不开，染色体数不会加倍。: Without centromere splitting, the two sister chromatids can't separate and the chromosome number won't double.
后期染色体数加倍（16 → 32），DNA 分子数不变（仍 32）——说「后期: In anaphase the chromosome number doubles (16 → 32) while the number of DNA molecules stays the same (still 32); saying "DNA also doubles in anaphase" is wrong.
后期：着丝粒分裂，姐妹染色单体分开成两条染色体，染色体数暂时加倍到 32，DNA: Anaphase: centromeres split, sister chromatids separate into two chromosomes, the chromosome number temporarily doubles to 32 while DNA is unchanged, and each pole receives a set identical to the parent cell's.
一个细胞怎样变成两个细胞？: How does one cell become two?
染色体变细长盘曲成染色质丝，纺锤丝消失，两极出现新的核膜和核仁；赤道板位置出现细: Chromosomes become long, thin, coiled chromatin threads, spindle fibers disappear, and new nuclear envelopes and nucleoli appear at the poles; a cell plate appears at the equatorial plate and gradually expands into a new cell wall; at the end of telophase each daughter cell has 16 chromosomes and 16 DNA, the same as the parent
动物细胞：细胞膜内凹缢裂: Animal cells: the membrane pinches inward
两套染色体到达两极后，每条染色体逐渐变成细长盘曲的染色质丝。: Once the two sets of chromosomes reach the poles, each chromosome gradually becomes a long, thin, coiled chromatin thread.
纺锤丝消失，出现新的核膜和核仁，形成两个新的细胞核。: Spindle fibers disappear and new nuclear envelopes and nucleoli appear, forming two new nuclei.
植物细胞在赤道板的位置出现细胞板，逐渐扩展形成新的细胞壁。: In plant cells a cell plate appears at the equatorial plate and gradually expands into a new cell wall.
去掉细胞板：植物细胞分不成两个细胞（动物细胞不形成细胞板，靠细胞膜内凹缢裂）。: Without the cell plate a plant cell can't divide into two (animal cells don't form a cell plate; their membrane pinches inward).
植物细胞末期形成细胞板；动物细胞末期细胞膜内凹缢裂——两者的染色体行为相同。: Plant cells form a cell plate in telophase; in animal cells the membrane pinches inward. The chromosome behavior is the same in both.
末期：染色体解螺旋成染色质丝，核膜核仁重建，植物细胞在赤道板处形成细胞板并扩展成: Telophase: chromosomes uncoil into chromatin threads, nuclear envelopes and nucleoli re-form, and in plant cells a cell plate forms at the equatorial plate and expands into a new cell wall; one cell becomes two daughter cells, each with 16 chromosomes, the same as the parent.
一个视野里有多少细胞正在分裂？: How many cells in one field are dividing?
取样框里 50 个细胞：样本 1 间期 45、前期 3、中期 1、后期 0、末期: 50 cells in the sampling frame: Sample 1 interphase 45, prophase 3, metaphase 1, anaphase 0, telophase 1 → 5 dividing (10.0%); Sample 2 interphase 45, prophase 2, metaphase 0, anaphase 1, telophase 2 → also 5 (10.0%)
分裂期的细胞数远少于间期细胞数。: Dividing cells are far fewer than interphase cells.
一个视野不一定凑齐五个时期：样本 1 里没有后期，样本 2 里没有中期。: One field doesn't necessarily contain all five phases: Sample 1 has no anaphase, Sample 2 has no metaphase.
把视野移到分生区一个新的区域再数一次，样本更大、比例更稳。: Move to a new area of the meristem and count again; a bigger sample gives a steadier ratio.
去掉计数：只能说「间期细胞多」，说不出多多少，也算不出各期时长。: Skip counting and you can only say "there are many interphase cells", not how many more, and you can't compute phase durations.
间期细胞最多（教材练习 1（1）的配套答案）：间期占细胞周期的 90%~95%。: Interphase cells are the most numerous (answer to textbook Exercise 1(1)): interphase takes 90%–95% of the cell cycle.
同一分生组织里各个细胞的分裂独立进行；取样框的 50 个细胞里，处于分裂期的只有: Cells in the same meristem divide independently; of the 50 cells in the sampling frame only 5 (10.0%) are dividing, and interphase cells are the vast majority.
用细胞数能算出各期有多长吗？: Can cell counts tell you how long each phase lasts?
切到样本 2 再点一次「记录一组」，让两个视野各记一行: Switch to Sample 2 and click "Record a set" again, so each field records one row
两个样本合计 100 个细胞：间期 90、前期 5、中期 1、后期 1、末期 3: The two samples total 100 cells: interphase 90, prophase 5, metaphase 1, anaphase 1, telophase 3; scaled to 12 h: interphase 10.8 h, prophase 0.6 h, metaphase 0.12 h, anaphase 0.12 h, telophase 0.36 h, division phase total 1.2 h
各期时长 = 该期细胞数 ÷ 总数 × 12 h: Phase duration = cells in phase ÷ total × 12 h
细胞数比例约等于各期时长比例（前提：各细胞的分裂是随机、独立进行的）。: The ratio of cell counts roughly equals the ratio of phase durations (assuming cells divide randomly and independently).
间期 90 个 ≈ 90%，折算 10.8 h，是全周期里最长的一段。: Interphase 90 cells ≈ 90%, i.e. 10.8 h, the longest part of the cycle.
分裂期四期里前期最长：5 个 ≈ 5%，折算 0.6 h。: Of the four division phases prophase is longest: 5 cells ≈ 5%, i.e. 0.6 h.
只记一个样本（50 个细胞）：末期只剩 1 个，比例误差太大。: With only one sample (50 cells), telophase has just 1 cell and the ratio error is too large.
用「各期细胞数 ÷ 计数总数 × 细胞周期」估算各期时长——这是教材讨论 2 给: Estimate each phase's duration as "cells in phase ÷ total counted × cell cycle"; this is the method given in textbook Discussion 2.
细胞数比 = 时期时长比：两个样本合计 100 个细胞里间期 90 个，折合 1: Cell-count ratio = phase-duration ratio: of 100 cells across two samples, 90 are in interphase, i.e. 10.8 h; 10 are dividing, i.e. 1.2 h. Interphase cells are most numerous because interphase is longest.
考核：估出分裂期大约有多长: Assessment: estimate roughly how long the division phase lasts
记满两个分生区视野（各点一次「记录一组」），合计分裂期细胞 8–12 个，保持: Record two meristem fields (click "Record a set" once for each), with 8–12 dividing cells in total, and hold for 15 seconds
达标横幅；开考 6 秒时视野会滑到伸长区（细胞变长、不再分裂，不分期），主读数掉: Pass banner; 6 seconds into the test the field slides into the elongation zone (cells elongate, stop dividing and have no phase), the main reading drops to 0, and you must move back to the meristem and re-record
8 ≤ 两个视野合计的分裂期细胞 ≤ 12: 8 ≤ dividing cells in the two fields combined ≤ 12
两个样本各 50 个细胞，合计 100 个。: Two samples of 50 cells each, 100 in total.
只能数分生区的视野：伸长区的细胞已经不再分裂、不在细胞周期里，不分期（世界的示意: Only meristem fields count: elongation-zone cells no longer divide, are outside the cell cycle and have no phase (illustrative).
8–12 个对应 8%~12%，即 12 h 里的 1.0–1.4 h，与分裂期: 8–12 cells correspond to 8%–12%, i.e. 1.0–1.4 h of 12 h, consistent with a 1.2 h division phase.
没有新内容：前八步都用上就能达标。: Nothing new: using the previous eight steps is enough to pass.
Division-phase duration ≈ share of dividing cells × cell cycle = 10% × 12 h = 1.2 h.
分裂期约占细胞周期的 10%，12 h 里约 1.2 h——用数出来的细胞数就能: The division phase takes about 10% of the cell cycle, about 1.2 h of 12 h; counted cells are enough to estimate the duration.
已换物镜：倍数与视场见世界标签: Objective changed: see the label for magnification and field size
换个视野：分生区样本 1 / 样本 2，或伸长区（对照）: Change field: meristem Sample 1 / Sample 2, or elongation zone (control)
视野滑出了分生区：到了伸长区，细胞变长、不再分裂（不分期）: The field slid out of the meristem into the elongation zone: cells elongate and stop dividing (no phase)
整体 · 制片台、细胞视野、一个细胞: Overview · slide bench, cell field, one cell
有丝分裂后期，一个细胞里的染色体数和 DNA 分子数（洋葱 16 条）: In mitotic anaphase, the number of chromosomes and DNA molecules in one cell (onion has 16)
着丝粒分裂，姐妹染色单体分开成两条染色体，染色体数 16 → 32；DNA 没有: Centromeres split and sister chromatids separate into two chromosomes, so chromosomes go 16 → 32; no new DNA is made, so it is still 32 (p.113).
细胞周期中「复制后染色体为 32 条」这个说法: The statement "after replication there are 32 chromosomes" in the cell cycle is
对，DNA 和染色体都加倍: Correct, both DNA and chromosomes double
错，染色体仍是 16 条，DNA 是 32 个: Wrong, there are still 16 chromosomes and 32 DNA
复制后染色体仍 16 条，增多的是 DNA（16 → 32）和姐妹染色单体（0: After replication there are still 16 chromosomes; what increases is DNA (16 → 32) and sister chromatids (0 → 32) (textbook Exercise 1(2), answer key).
制片流程中「漂洗」这一步的目的: The purpose of the "rinsing" step in slide preparation is
使细胞相互分离: To separate the cells from one another
洗去药液，防止解离过度: To wash off the reagent and prevent over-dissociation
教材 p.116 的表：漂洗的目的就是「洗去药液，防止解离过度」。: Table on textbook p.116: the purpose of rinsing is to wash off the reagent and prevent over-dissociation.
视野里细胞数量最多的是: The most numerous cells in the field are in
间期占细胞周期的 90%~95%，时间最长，所以间期细胞最多（教材练习 1（1）: Interphase takes 90%–95% of the cell cycle, the longest time, so interphase cells are most numerous (textbook Exercise 1(1), answer key).
看懂有丝分裂各期的染色体行为，会用细胞数估算各期时长。: Understand chromosome behavior in each phase of mitosis, and use cell counts to estimate phase durations.
示意声明：根尖示意放大 2 倍、细胞视野为示意放大、时期动作为示意；时长按 12: Disclaimer: the root tip is shown at 2× schematic magnification, the cell field is a schematic enlargement and phase motions are illustrative; durations are scaled to 12 h.
顺序不对：先解离，再漂洗、染色，最后制片: Wrong order: dissociate first, then rinse, stain and finally mount
